title.zh: Crypto Reacts: Bitcoin Slides as Clarity Act Fails to Clear Senate Vote
title.en: Crypto Reacts: Bitcoin Slides as Clarity Act Fails to Clear Senate Vote

current_state.zh: The Senate failed to invoke cloture on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act by a 49-50 vote, sending Bitcoin down roughly 3-4% to around $76,000 as the bill's advancement stalled.
current_state.en: The Senate failed to invoke cloture on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act by a 49-50 vote, sending Bitcoin down roughly 3-4% to around $76,000 as the bill's advancement stalled.
